name: fabius
description: fabius — one super-skill that equips Claude end-to-end under a single Fabian stance: scout wide, strike narrow. Write lean code and lean prose, run a disciplined brainstorm→plan→TDD→verify→debug loop, design ship-grade UI, build and orchestrate other agents, and keep a persistent memory so it stops re-deriving. One install, six coordinated zero-overlap skills: an always-on lean core, a router, and four engineering specialists. Capabilities: terse output, a YAGNI code ladder, root-cause debugging, design tokens + one-accent laws, least-privilege agent definitions, index+log knowledge base. Actions: write, build, fix, debug, refactor, review, design, plan, verify, remember. Lean by default, never flimsy.
